infobox.usage: Unlocks the livingroom in apartment 6 on the second floor of the Primorsky 48 building on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Primorsky 48 apartment key (Prim 48) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the apartments at Primorsky Ave 48.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Living room door in apartment 6 on the second floor of the Primorsky 48 building at Streets of Tarkov. The entrance is on the backyard side.
